# Getting Support

Looking for help with **AirlockVM**? Please start with the documentation below before opening an issue.

## Documentation
- **[5-Minute Quickstart](../QUICKSTART.md)** — Installation, multi-IDE connector (`connect_airlock.sh`), and first deployment.
- **[Zero-Workload Use Case](../USECASE.md)** — Motivation and workstation/hypervisor separation model.
- **[Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** — Two-tier hypervisor topology, resource sizing, `qcow2` storage, and socket proxying.
- **[Security Architecture](../docs/SECURITY.md)** — 5-layer isolation model, rootless hypervisor setup, and hardening.
- **[MCP Server Reference](../docs/MCP_SERVER.md)** — Complete `airlock-mcp` tool schemas and usage.
- **[Integration Testing Guide](../docs/INTEGRATION_TESTING.md)** — Verification matrix and local test execution.

## Reporting Bugs & Requesting Features
- **Found a bug?** Open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/simplybarter/AirlockVM/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your OS, Python, and `virsh` versions plus command output.
- **Have an enhancement idea?** Open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/simplybarter/AirlockVM/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

## Security Vulnerabilities
**Do not report security issues publicly.** Follow our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) to submit a private report via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting.
